credits.title: Hakki

He provides for them by selling statuettes in front of the nearby ancient city as well as guiding local tours. credits.title: Crybaby
credits.overview: Elif is going abroad for her master’s degree and her friends throw a surprise farewell party for her. Unexpected tensions arise at the party and Elif starts seeing demons that are only visible to her. She is all alone with her demons in the crowd.

credits.title: Murat Göğebakan: Kalbim Yaralı
credits.overview: Turkish singer Murat Göğebakan embarks on a successful musical career, until he receives a terminal cancer diagnosis.

credits.title: My Grandfather's People
credits.overview: A feature film that tells the story of the director's grandfather who was forced to leave Crete in the 1920s during the Greek-Turkish population exchange.
